billing.email.SendEmail/outcome/failed.purpose: `billing.email.SendEmail` answers `failed` for the cause it declares as external, injected

billing.email.SendEmail/outcome/sent.purpose: `billing.email.SendEmail` answers `sent` for an input no other branch's guard claims

billing.invoice.CancelInvoice/outcome/ca.purpose: `billing.invoice.CancelInvoice` answers `cancelled` for an input no other branch's guard claims

billing.invoice.CancelInvoice/outcome/wr.purpose: `billing.invoice.CancelInvoice` for an identity no record carries takes `wrong-state` and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`

billing.invoice.CreateInvoice/outcome/ac.purpose: `billing.invoice.CreateInvoice` answers `accepted` for an input that satisfies that branch's guard

billing.invoice.CreateInvoice/outcome/re.purpose: `billing.invoice.CreateInvoice` answers `rejected` for an input no other branch's guard claims

billing.invoice.Invoice/invariant/after/.purpose: a `billing.invoice.Invoice` still satisfies what it declares after `billing.invoice.CancelInvoice` on `cancelled`
a `billing.invoice.Invoice` still satisfies what it declares after `billing.invoice.CreateInvoice` on `accepted`
a `billing.invoice.Invoice` still satisfies what it declares after `billing.invoice.IssueInvoice` on `issued`
a `billing.invoice.Invoice` still satisfies what it declares after `billing.invoice.PayInvoice` on `settled`

billing.invoice.Invoice/state/Cancelled/.purpose: `billing.invoice.CancelInvoice` does not move a `billing.invoice.Invoice` that is in `Cancelled`, and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`
`billing.invoice.IssueInvoice` does not move a `billing.invoice.Invoice` that is in `Cancelled`, and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`
`billing.invoice.PayInvoice` does not move a `billing.invoice.Invoice` that is in `Cancelled`, and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`

billing.invoice.Invoice/state/Draft/refu.purpose: `billing.invoice.PayInvoice` does not move a `billing.invoice.Invoice` that is in `Draft`, and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`

billing.invoice.Invoice/state/Issued/ref.purpose: `billing.invoice.IssueInvoice` does not move a `billing.invoice.Invoice` that is in `Issued`, and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`

billing.invoice.Invoice/state/Paid/refus.purpose: `billing.invoice.CancelInvoice` does not move a `billing.invoice.Invoice` that is in `Paid`, and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`
`billing.invoice.IssueInvoice` does not move a `billing.invoice.Invoice` that is in `Paid`, and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`
`billing.invoice.PayInvoice` does not move a `billing.invoice.Invoice` that is in `Paid`, and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`

billing.invoice.IssueInvoice/outcome/iss.purpose: `billing.invoice.IssueInvoice` answers `issued` for an input no other branch's guard claims

billing.invoice.IssueInvoice/outcome/wro.purpose: `billing.invoice.IssueInvoice` for an identity no record carries takes `wrong-state` and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`

billing.invoice.Money/invariant/at/billi.purpose: every `billing.invoice.Money` that `billing.invoice.InvoiceById` publishes at `total` satisfies what the type declares
every `billing.invoice.Money` that `billing.invoice.OutstandingInvoices` publishes at `total` satisfies what the type declares

billing.invoice.PayInvoice/outcome/rejec.purpose: `billing.invoice.PayInvoice` answers `rejected` for an input no other branch's guard claims

billing.invoice.PayInvoice/outcome/settl.purpose: `billing.invoice.PayInvoice` answers `settled` for an input that satisfies that branch's guard

billing.invoice.PayInvoice/outcome/wrong.purpose: `billing.invoice.PayInvoice` for an identity no record carries takes `wrong-state` and reports `billing.invoice.InvoiceStateConflict`

notify-on-invoice-created/binding/delive.purpose: `billing.invoice.InvoiceCreated` delivered twice still leaves `billing.email.EmailSent` observable, and no count is required

notify-on-invoice-created/binding/mappin.purpose: `notify-on-invoice-created` fills `billing.email.SendEmail` from `billing.invoice.InvoiceCreated` as it is mapped
